# Code of conduct

FreeOSINT-UI follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/). In short:

- Be respectful and welcoming, whatever someone's experience, background or identity.
- Give and accept constructive feedback; focus on the work, not the person.
- No harassment, insults, personal attacks, or sexual language and imagery.

## OSINT-specific rules

This is an OSINT project, so a few extra rules apply to issues, pull requests and discussions:

- Don't post personal data of real people (emails, phone numbers, addresses, usernames, lookup results) unless it is yours or already public test data.
- Don't use the project's spaces to target, dox or harass anyone.
- Don't ask for help with unauthorized access, stalking or other illegal uses.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior to the maintainer, [kerlo](https://github.com/Kerlooo), privately (for example on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/carlo-scaglione/)). Reports are handled confidentially.

The maintainer may edit or remove comments, issues and pull requests, and temporarily or permanently ban anyone whose behavior breaks this code of conduct, as described in the [Contributor Covenant enforcement guidelines](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/#enforcement-guidelines).
